gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.

gaps.lead: She speaks French better than her brother does.
gaps.explanation: 'Doesn't speak French as well as' reverses the comparison.

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.answer: as close to the beach as
gaps.lead: The hotel was further from the beach than we expected.
gaps.explanation: further than expected = not as close (to the beach) as expected.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly so that the interpreter could follow.
I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = tell nobody.
